title: Week 26: BabylonJS graphical development, Godot CI and TallinnJS
content:
Week 26: BabylonJS graphical development, Godot CI and TallinnJS

BabylonJS Graphical Development

This week I tried Babylon Editor and Babylon Toolkit for a graphical development environment. I found Babylon Editor is more easier to use.

Godot CI

I was asked to attend a GameJam in China. My team wanted to use godot to make a landlord simulator. I used chickensoft-games/setup-godot to setup github action for this game. It supports godot v4+. It is much easier than Unity. ChickenSoft provides tons of godot toolkit that is nice to try.

TallinnJS

I attended TallinnJS this week. There are two lectures, one for telegram mini app, the other is CSS for responsive design. Loud shout to Kateryna's blog. And Utopia a website to test responsive design.

RapidAPI

I was doing a research for a project, which probably needs a scrapper. I found RapidAPI. The free version allows 2k calls a month. It is enough for me, but I am not sure about the project.
